lines.text: 未来不是一条直线，它布满了十字路口。一定有一个我们能亲手选择的未来。
lines.en: The future is not a straight line. It is filled with many crossroads. There must be a future that we can choose for ourselves.
lines.note: IMDb quotes 逐字核证（tt0094625）；超能力少女清子的预言。
